name: Turkey
spiritual_teacher: Jalal al-Din Rumi / Sufism (Konya — center of the Mevlevi / dervish order, ancient Sufi wisdom)
work_strategy: Remote (Tourist/humanitarian residence permit; working on the local market prohibited without a special permit)
it_market: Local (Large domestic market, but Turkish is required)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0; thereafter 15–40% progressive PIT; Ukrainian 5% Single Tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Very warm (Mediterranean, subtropical, Antalya/Alanya — warm winter)
nature: Top Sea + Mountains (Mediterranean, Aegean, Black Sea; Taurus Mountains, Cappadocia)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: International passport or ID card. Visa-free 90 days out of 180.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: NO EU-directive temporary protection. Available: tourist residence permit (up to 2 years), humanitarian residence permit (1 year), or International Protection (refugee status).
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **Non-EU country. EU directives restricting protection for conscription-liable persons DO NOT APPLY HERE.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: No state payments (one-off food packages from municipalities or ASAM projects may be available).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: No state housing; self-paid rent or volunteer support only.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Paid mandatory insurance (SGK or private). Free healthcare only when applying for refugee status.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: No benefits for Ukrainians (Istanbulkart in Istanbul is paid).
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Tourist and humanitarian residence permits do NOT grant work rights! Work is possible only with a work visa or 6 months after applying for refugee status.

items: [Sahibinden.com](https://www.sahibinden.com/) — absolute leader and monopoly of the rental market in Turkey (Antalya, Alanya, Istanbul).
[Zingat.com](https://www.zingat.com/) — portal with price analytics and neighborhood ratings.
